geometry: The full integral matching polytope of K_n in its canonical edge-incidence coordinates, endowed with the standard Euclidean metric.
integrity: An analytic argument using symmetry-averaged Euclidean balls, all genuine matching-polytope facet inequalities, exact phase comparisons, and matching-vertex cardinalities; independently corroborated by LP and vertex enumeration for n=2..9.
scientific_limitations: No claim for arbitrary affine realizations, general graphs, or external formal/expert certification. Literature priority is best-of-knowledge with explicitly recorded residual risks.
title: Exact Euclidean radii and contact-facet phase of complete-graph matching polytopes
